en.title: Index of the First Anagram Substring
en.description:
Given strings s and pattern of lowercase English letters, return the starting index of the earliest contiguous substring of s whose character frequencies exactly match those of pattern; if none exists, return -1.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: Two lines, containing s and pattern respectively. This site restricts the character set to ASCII lowercase letters; 1≤|s|,|pattern|≤200000.
en.output: Output the earliest starting index (0-based); if none exists, output -1.
en.explanation: Use a sliding window of length |pattern| to maintain the counts of the 26 letters. Check the windows one by one; the first position whose counts equal those of pattern is the answer.
hints: Use a sliding window of length |pattern| to maintain the counts of the 26 letters. Check the windows one by one; the first position whose counts equal those of pattern is the answer.
